findings.issue: ExprDepthBounded remains exprMaxStackDepth e ≤ 52 AND exprDepth e ≤ 55. REPORT claims the old exprDepth ≤ 55 cap was eliminated and that stack ≤ 52 plus 10 outer levels yields document depth ≤ 62 < 64. The 55 conjunct is still in source. ProbeR10 (child_compiler_exit 0): wrapNow 51 (AST 52, stack 52) stackLe52 true, document nest 58, decodeBytes ok-eq. wrapNow 52 (AST 53, stack 53) stackLe52 false, depthLe55 true, nest 59, decodeBytes ok-eq. wrapNow 55 (AST 56) nest 62 ok-eq. wrapNow 57 (AST 58) nest 64 ok-eq. Outer framing on the typed-execute guard path is 6 (witness nest 6; 6+stack), not 10. The 52 cap excludes decoder-admitted guards at JSON depth 59–64. The 55 conjunct does not bind once stack ≤ 52, because stack ≥ AST depth on these constructors. TemplateDepthBounded now walks guard, deltas.amount, and supplyDeltas.amount. That is R10 progress relative to R9's guard-only bound. It is not a whole-document JSON-depth equivalence, and it still uses the 52/55 conjuncts. No kernel SupportedIR membership proof; the probe printed Nat.ble, not decide ExprDepthBounded. Do not shrink grammar to make the theorem true.

findings.source: Correspondence.lean exprMaxStackDepth Encode.lean encodeExpr encodePackedCellRef encodeUnaryOp encodeBinaryOp
findings.issue: exprMaxStackDepth is constructor-sensitive but is not exact production JSON nesting. ProbeR10 encodeNest versus claimed stack: now 1=1, litBool/litNum/arg/timestamp 2=2, observe 3=3, unaryNotNow 2=2, binAnd 2=2. Mismatches: balance claimed 3 actual encodeNest 4 (packedCellRef + cellRef + partyRef owner object); unaryNegNow claimed 2 actual 3 (op.numeric object); binAdd claimed 2 actual 3. REPORT's displayed definition assigns every leaf 1; frozen source uses 2 or 3 for several leaves. The 52 cap is therefore both an undercount on some constructors and an over-restriction on now-unary guards. There is no proved equivalence between exprMaxStackDepth, encodeExpr nesting, and scanLexical/parseStep depth 64.

findings.source: Decode.lean decodeBytes parseCanonicalJson remap; Check.lean checkBytes; CanonicalJson.lean feedValue; Decode.lean scanLexical
findings.issue: decodeBytes maps every parseCanonicalJson error to notJsonObject. checkBytes maps resourceLimit to blocked and every other decode error to malformed. Grammar requires exceeded resource limits to be CodecResult.blocked. ProbeR10 raw 4097-element array: scanLexical ok, parseCanonicalJson resourceLimit max_array_length, decodeBytes notJsonObject, checkBytes malformed:notJsonObject. Scanner comma-count admits 4097; parser refuses the 4097th. Public refusal still happens; the classification is malformed rather than blocked. SupportedIR membership is not required for this raw-byte classification test. Decode and Check hashes are unchanged from R9. This is a frozen R10 defect already assigned to R11; it is not treated as repaired.

findings.source: Correspondence.lean EncodeDecodeRoundtripStatement decodeExpr_exprToJson decodePackedValue_canonical decodeRegistry_registryToJson CanonicalJson.lean tokenizeFuel_string parseTokens_*
findings.issue: EncodeDecodeRoundtripStatement remains def Prop. Fresh axiom audit printed 150 named theorems, all standard axioms only (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound); three have empty axiom lists. That is compiler-proved helper progress, not the universal IR theorem. decodeExprFuel_exprToJson / decodeExpr_exprToJson invert exprToJson through decodeExprFuel 64 under ExprCanonical and AST depth ≤ 64, not encodeExpr/encodeModule. decodePackedValue_canonical inverts packedValueFullToJson, not encodePackedValue bytes. packedValueToJson for bool is Json.bool. decodeRegistry_registryToJson assumes RegistryCanonical (Nodup + TemplateCanonical). decodeTemplate_templateToJson assumes TemplateCanonical. decodeSourcePin_sourcePinToJson requires compiler_record = none and audit_record = none and uses sourcePinToJson, which omits those keys; production encodeSourcePin emits them. decodeStateCell_stateCellToJson requires nonneg, which matches grammar stateNonneg. tokenizeFuel_string connects escaped character lists to a string token plus remaining tokenizeFuel; parseTokens_* invert singleton token lists. There is no proved tokenize-then-parseCanonicalJson-then-decodeBytes of encodeModule bytes. decodeBytes_encode_canonical and decode_encode_roundtrip_of_decode assume prior decodeBytes = .ok. No componentToJson inversion exists despite production encodeComponent/decodeComponent. A valid helper is progress and is not full encodeModule/decodeBytes proof.
